h1: Drinkware OEM Manufacturing from Specification to Production
lead: Bring your cup specification, drawing or product reference to our factory team. We turn the brief into a design proposal, product mockup and defined manufacturing project.
html:
Start with the existing or new-tool route

An existing model uses the selected product configuration. A new shape needs structure development, tooling planning and sample approval before bulk production.

Define the production reference

Record the material, dimensions, components, artwork and packing together. The approved model and sample form the shared reference for the project quotation and production handoff.
